text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows significant hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild monocytosis, eosinophilia, and basophilia. There is also a low total CO₂, suggesting possible metabolic acidosis. Renal and liver function, as well as electrolytes, are within normal limits. Findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or infiltration, and possible underlying infection or inflammatory process. Clinical correlation is recommended.
